name: std-knowledge-loop
description: std-knowledge-loop — generic epistemic-loop / decision-gate machinery. Use when a user voices that a claim, hypothesis, or fix needs to be varied, predicted, falsified, independently checked, and calibrated before it is trusted (root-cause investigation, hypothesis testing, a fix that needs sign-off before it ships, a claim that needs a second opinion). The topology (vary -> compare -> hypothesize -> predict -> falsify -> verify -> generalize -> isolate & intervene -> compose -> calibrate -> select next target -> vary again) is fixed and never re-authored per domain. Each gate is announced: entering falsification emits FalsificationRequested, entering verification emits VerificationRequested, entering calibration emits CalibrationRequested (all carry the claim's title + candidateStructure). Who answers a gate is the consumer's call: with manualFalsification / manualVerification on (the default) the atom renders Survived/Failed and Checks-agree/Checks-disagree buttons and a person judges; a consumer that can compute the verdict sets the knob off, authors a sibling trait that listens for the *Requested event, does the domain check, and emits its result, then overrides listens {} at the call site to route that result into SURVIVED/FAILED or CHECKS_AGREE/CHECKS_DISAGREE — the `when` guard on that route IS the consumer's definition of what the gate means (e.g. ReproCheck.REPRO_RESULT -> SURVIVED when (>= ?passRate 0.95)). Calibration is enforced by the atom itself: a submitted numeric score is checked against reliabilityThreshold. On a claim clearing calibration, emits LoopConcluded (title, reliabilityScore) so a composing host can act on the validated result.

manualFalsification.description: On: the falsification gate renders Survived / Failed buttons and a person decides. Off: no buttons render; the consumer's own sibling trait must answer FalsificationRequested by routing its result into SURVIVED / FAILED through a listens override.
manualFalsification.label: Falsification is judged by a person
manualFalsification.synonyms: manual falsification, human judged, automated check off

manualVerification.description: On: the verification gate renders Checks-agree / Checks-disagree buttons. Off: the consumer's sibling trait answers VerificationRequested by routing its result into CHECKS_AGREE / CHECKS_DISAGREE through a listens override.
manualVerification.label: Verification is judged by a person
manualVerification.synonyms: manual verification, human second opinion, automated cross-check off

reliabilityThreshold.description: The measured reliability score a calibrated claim must clear before it is considered good enough to act on. Below it, the loop returns to falsification for more testing.
reliabilityThreshold.label: Reliability threshold
reliabilityThreshold.synonyms: confidence threshold, calibration bar, minimum reliability

requireIndependentVerification.description: Whether a second, independent check must agree before the claim advances. Off skips straight to generalization once falsification survives.
requireIndependentVerification.label: Require independent verification

emits.description: The loop entered the falsification gate. A consumer that computes the verdict listens for this, runs its check, and routes its result into SURVIVED or FAILED via a listens override.
emits.synonyms: falsify, test the prediction, try to break it

emits.description: The loop entered the independent-verification gate. A consumer routes its second-method result into CHECKS_AGREE or CHECKS_DISAGREE via a listens override.
The loop entered the calibration gate and is waiting for a reliability score (CONFIRM_SCORE, data.score), which the atom checks against reliabilityThreshold.
A claim cleared calibration; a composing host can act on the validated result.
emits.synonyms: validated, calibrated, concluded, ready to ship

events.description: The investigation's title and current hypothesis were entered.
events.name: Change Condition

events.description: The loop entered the falsification gate. A consumer that computes the verdict listens for this, runs its check, and routes its result into SURVIVED or FAILED via a listens override.
events.name: Falsification requested
events.synonyms: falsify, test the prediction, try to break it

events.description: The loop entered the independent-verification gate. A consumer routes its second-method result into CHECKS_AGREE or CHECKS_DISAGREE via a listens override.
events.name: Verification requested

events.description: The loop entered the calibration gate and is waiting for a reliability score (CONFIRM_SCORE, data.score), which the atom checks against reliabilityThreshold.
events.name: Calibration requested

events.description: A claim cleared calibration; a composing host can act on the validated result.
events.name: Loop concluded
events.synonyms: validated, calibrated, concluded, ready to ship
